int_name: N 26TH ST & CECIL B MOORE AVE

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized urban intersection with mixed-use residential and commercial buildings. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and marked crosswalks are present, the markings are faded and the environment lacks modern traffic calming features like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings on the side street are significantly worn, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, crossing the side street

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and utility poles near the intersection corners may block sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street and intersection corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and mixed-use residential and commercial buildings. While the narrow roadway naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds, the pedestrian environment is hindered by faded crosswalk markings and sightline obstructions from parked cars.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings in the foreground are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right side of the street may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility for motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving, but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian-specific signals. The roadway is wide and unmarked, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds and reduce driver awareness of crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a pedestrian crossing area, reducing driver yielding rates.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area across the asphalt

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but no dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing intervals.

hazards.name: Roadway Surface Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway can create trip hazards or affect vehicle braking.
